notes.title: Monster Girl Jungle Released!
notes.content:
Game is released!
I hope everyone enjoys my new project.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3557720/Monster_Girl_Jungle"][/dynamiclink]

H-Scenes: 2 → 20

(Certain types of content scenes not included in this count)

New Minigame

Updated UI

Expanded Gallery

Achievements Added

Bug Fixes

Translation Improvements

Performance Enhancements

Lovense Support Added
